What is Jev AI? The AI model that can't write a single sentence 🤯

Jev is TypeSafe AI's new "System One" model (early access since Sept 2026).
💬 an LLM writes paragraphs
✅ Jev returns a decision: you send your app's state + questions with fixed answers, it returns the answer + a probability

No essay. Nothing to parse.
An LLM writes. Jev decides.

yt_description:
What is Jev AI? Jev is TypeSafe AI's System One model (early access, Sept 2026).
Instead of writing text like an LLM, Jev takes your app's state plus questions with fixed answers (choice, score, yes/no) and returns typed answers with calibrated probabilities.
